_comment: Template for a composed React app's package.json. Copy to
Versions are PINNED deliberately. No template shipped here before, so the
composer chose versions from memory and picked next@15.1.6, which npm install
immediately flagged as carrying a security vulnerability (CVE-2025-66478).
Every version below was resolved and audited clean with `npm audit` at the time
of writing: next 15.x pulls a postcss <=8.5.22 with four open advisories, and
the fix is a semver-major move to 16.x, which is why this pins 16.
tailwindcss is pinned to 3.x on purpose: the library's utility classes assume
the v3 config-file model, and v4's CSS-first model would need different config
files than the three shipped alongside this template.
Re-audit before trusting these: advisories move. `npm audit` on a fresh install
is the check, not this comment.
name: bi-report
